about.title: Francisco José D'Alessandro
about.subtitle: Full Stack Developer
about.description: I am a Full Stack developer with intensive training in web development. My approach focuses on problem-solving, agile learning, logical thinking, and autonomy in both Frontend and Backend development. I use technologies like React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, and MongoDB. My proactive attitude, effective communication, teamwork, and experience as a Teacher Assistant allow me to develop real-world projects, implement automated testing, design software architectures, and perform production deployments.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Some of my most outstanding works

myBalance.title: My-Balance - Personal Finance Management
myBalance.description: My-Balance is a Full Stack personal finance management application designed to centralize and visualize the user's finances. It allows users to manage expenses and income, payrolls, bank imports, savings and debts, as well as generate financial reports and predictions. The platform includes secure authentication, document management and a responsive interface designed to provide a clear and comprehensive view of the user's financial situation.

smartQR.title: SmartQR - Restaurant Management System
smartQR.description: Complete web application for restaurant management with QR code system, real-time orders, and administrative panel.

techStore.title: TechStore - E-commerce
techStore.description: E-commerce platform with authentication system, shopping cart, and integrated payment gateway.

sipma.title: SIPMA - Infrastructure Project Management
sipma.description: SIPMA is a platform for infrastructure and construction companies that automates project management, control and tracking, reducing time, cost overruns and risks. It simplifies administration from planning to project closure with full transparency and control. In this project I worked on custom JavaScript and HTML plugins embedded into Bubble, as well as configuring workflows and views directly inside the platform.
